budget_items.what_was_recorded: Jay Simeone reported a federal RAISE grant of $25 million and that Gardner is receiving $1.25 million of it.
budget_items.quote: jay simeone states there is a 25-million-dollar federal grant funding, titled the raise program, to rebuild american infrastructure

budget_items.topic: FY 25 budget schedule and budget process
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The committee reviewed the FY 25 budget calendar and discussed that the budget process has been rushed; Dave Passios proposed an earlier Town Manager budget submission. No dollar figures printed.
budget_items.quote: below is the current budget schedule for fy 25

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Dave Passios said consolidation is not going to save money and will probably cost money, but that the town has held back on growth.
budget_items.quote: dave passios believes consolidation is not going to save money and it will probably cost us money

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The task force charge covers a 3-to-5-year fiscal plan, revenue and expenditure trends, Proposition 2½ overrides and exclusions, and whether to assess tax and fee increases. No dollar figures printed.
budget_items.quote: capital project funding needs and impacts, assess any increase taxes and fees,

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Dave Passios reported Senator Cronin's proposal to implement a local income tax by reducing the Prop 2½ levy increase, with no change to Prop 2½; described as a 2-3 year process.
budget_items.quote: senator cronin wants to implement a local income tax by reducing the percentage that we increase our budget by under prop 2 ½

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Dave Passios noted discussion at a prior Select Board meeting about outstanding unappropriated ARPA funding and small capital projects that could move infrastructure forward. No dollar figures printed.
budget_items.quote: dave passios states at a prior select board meeting there was discussion about outstanding unappropriated arpa funding.

budget_items.topic: State aid and Chapter 70 inflation rider
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The School Committee's list of concerns includes state funding, specifically an inflation rider to Chapter 70; the PTO suggested focusing on the cherry sheet, where legislators can influence the budget. No dollar figures printed.
budget_items.quote: state funding specifically an inflation rider to chapter 70

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Evan Watters contacted the DPW Director to discuss Chapter 90 funding. No dollar figures printed.
